claims: Sean Penn has won three Academy Awards from six nominations.
Sean Penn won Best Actor for Mystic River (2003).
Sean Penn won Best Actor for Milk (2008).
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for One Battle After Another (2026).
Sean Penn received a Best Actor nomination for Dead Man Walking (1995).
Sean Penn received a Best Actor nomination for Sweet and Lowdown (1999).
Sean Penn received a Best Actor nomination for I Am Sam (2001).
According to reports, Sean Penn did not attend the 2026 ceremony in person.
